title: Questions and Answers — Tenure Tolerance on the Class H Preferred Stock Holding Ceiling, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
A long-held Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding carries a tenure tolerance on its holding ceiling.

## The rule

The holding-ceiling tenure tolerance rests on the holding's age: a holding issued at least 120 whole months before today gives USD 5000; at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months gives USD 2500; a younger holding gives none.

The tolerance is a dollar amount added to the holding ceiling before the excess over the ceiling is taken.

## Questions answered

**How is age measured?** In whole months from the holding's issue date to today.

**A holding issued 119 whole months ago?** USD 2500. At 120 whole months it gives USD 5000.

**A holding issued 59 whole months ago?** None; 60 whole months are needed for USD 2500.

| Age of the holding | Tenure tolerance |
|---|---|
| 120 whole months or more | USD 5000 |
| 60 to 119 whole months | USD 2500 |
| Fewer than 60 whole months | None |
